verdict.rationale: The evidence documents per-document operations only: convert, extract, segment, form filling, and single-file CLI conversion. Nothing shows a batch endpoint, a multi-file CLI mode, or bulk processing across many items. Pipelines chain processors on a document, and file storage allows reuse across calls. Both are adjacent building blocks, not a bulk-operation capability, so this applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
